title: Unlimited Sandbox
body:
![Its a title that says "unlimited sandbox"](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c9f1bcd071dfb1cf073863456c11358e984f4150.png)


🔴100+ Quests

🔴World Generation Improved and Overhauled (Terralith, Good Ending)

🔴Thousands of Structures and Dungeons (Dungeon Now Loading, Dungeons and Taverns)

🔴Overhauled base game dungeons and stronghold (Integrated Dungeons and Structures)

🔴2 New Dimensions: The Aether And The Otherside 

🔴Rideable dragons and tons of new tameable pets (Dragon Mounts: Legacy, Ice and Fire)

🔴Multiplayer support and features (Essential, Emojiful)

🔴Many Qol features and base game improvements

🔴450+ mods

THIS MODPACK REQUIRES AT LEAST 8G OF RAM
